metadata.description: A repo-agnostic Claude Code kit: harness (instincts + security hooks), discipline skills, a domain-language layer, and explicit user-only workflows — plus an optional, pinned security-audit companion.

plugins.name: keystone
plugins.description: The keystone plugin: skills (auto-invoked discipline and domain-language, plus user-only workflows like /spec, /implement, /qa, /ship, /cso, /guard) and the instincts/guard/scan/notify/learnings harness hooks.

plugins.name: security-audit
plugins.description: Optional companion, not part of keystone: Cloudflare's security-audit skill (MIT), pinned to a fixed commit. Adds a source-first full-audit mode with coverage ledgers and schema-validated findings; keystone's /cso can hand off to it. Install separately; never auto-enabled.
